text: Characterized by a range of cognitive challenges, attention disorder has garnered significant attention and widespread publicity. The aspects most attributed to this condition are weaknesses in maintaining or sustaining attention over time and across tasks. This disorder, diagnosed as ADHD, has also been the subject of extensive research and debates, emphasizing its impact on individuals. The American Psychiatric Association (2022) defines ADHD as a persistent pattern of inattention, hyperactivity-impulsivity, or a combination that interferes with functioning or development, and symptoms exhibited in two or more settings (e.g., at home, school, or work) with direct negative impacts on areas such as social, academic, or occupational functioning.
